title: Uth Vaikh Kay Terian Bhehna
body:
Uth Vaikh Kay Terian Bhehna I Harram Mola Abbas AS I Guldasta e Jafferia
<<DIVIDER>>
Sangat Anjuman e Guldasta e Jaffria
Holy Shrine Hazrat Abbas AS
Karbala
Noha Mola Abbas
Mola Abbas Noha
